# Brainstorm — Portable Fallback

Use when the objective is understood but the solution space is still genuinely open.

## Workflow

1. Preserve the user's outcome and hard constraints.
2. Clarify only ambiguities that change candidate solutions.
3. Generate materially different mechanisms, not cosmetic variants.
4. Remove options violating constraints.
5. Compare viable options on shared axes.
6. Identify the best evidence/prototype needed to choose.
7. Hand serious candidates to Reasoning/Plan.

Do not force brainstorming when the user already chose a direction or when one approach clearly dominates.
